documents.title: University of Maryland, Baltimore Artificial Intelligence (AI) Guidelines
documents.summary: University-wide AI guidelines from the Provost, CITS, Counsel and CHHS, organized by audience (instructors, students, researchers, administrators). It leaves classroom permission to each instructor, treats undisclosed or prohibited use as misconduct, discourages reliance on detectors, and spends much space on data protection, HIPAA, FERPA and approved tools.
documents.stance_why: The guidelines say "UMB does not dictate that faculty and instructors shall require or prohibit the use of generative AI" and "It will be at the course instructor's discretion", so the document sets no stance of its own and delegates.
